label: Napoli Yoke with Double Darts
description: The Napoli yoke with double darts pairs a Neapolitan-style yoke construction with two shaping darts at the back, blending soft tailoring with a fitted waist. The darts draw the shirt in through the midsection for a trim line while the yoke gives a clean shoulder. It is a sartorial, southern-Italian-inspired finish favored for a refined, body-following fit.
